# TechBridge

> Tech NGO empowering innovators through hackathons, bootcamps, internships, mentorship, and digital skills training across 45+ countries.

TechBridge runs hands-on programs, a public events calendar, a blog, mentor directory, project showcase, community forum, and a verifiable certificate system.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of programs, impact, and featured events
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, leadership, and impact numbers
- [Programs](/programs): Hackathons, bootcamps, internships, workshops
- [Events](/events): Upcoming and past events with registration
- [Services](/services): Software, web, mobile, training, and hackathon services
- [Mentors](/mentors): Browse mentors and request 1:1 mentorship
- [Projects](/projects): Community project showcase
- [Blog](/blog): Articles, case studies, and announcements
- [Forum](/forum): Community discussions
- [Verify Certificate](/verify): Public certificate verification
- [Contact](/contact): Partnerships and support
